abort.single_instance_allowed: HATS Lite is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.

apply_theme.name: Apply theme
apply_theme.description: Applies a theme for a user. The change is made through a short lived manual assignment that the target's open session applies live, ending after 24 hours unless a duration is given. The user's own later choice takes over again. Without a user, the calling user is the target.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Name of an installed theme, or default.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Light or dark variant. Auto keeps the choice of the theme.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds the theme stays in place, from 60 to 2592000.

user.name: User
user.description: User id or user name. Defaults to the calling user.

assign_theme.name: Assign theme
assign_theme.description: Assigns a theme to a user as a manual assignment that lasts until removed, or for the given duration. Admins may assign to anyone, assigners to non admin users, other users only to themselves. A theme a user assigns to themselves always ends (24 hours by default) and replaces their previous self assigned theme. Users who opted out of assigned themes are refused.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Name of an installed theme, or default.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Light or dark variant. Auto keeps the choice of the theme.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds the theme stays in place, from 60 to 2592000.

user.name: User
user.description: User id or user name of the target.

revert_now.name: Revert now
revert_now.description: Cancels the running safe try for a user, or ends the theme the user applied to themselves, so the user's own choice shows again. Themes assigned by others are never touched. Without a user, the calling user is the target. Returns what was reverted: trial, override or none.

user.name: User
user.description: User id or user name. Defaults to the calling user. Only admins and assigners may name another user.

unauthorized.message: You are not allowed to change the theme of this user.

opted_out.message: This user opted out of assigned themes.

invalid_range.message: The duration is out of range.

limit_reached.message: The limit of assignments for this user is reached.
